declarations.docstring: An additive equivalence at a natural-number degree in the setting of a projective resolution over an algebra.
A linear equivalence over the base field at a natural-number degree in the setting of a projective resolution over an algebra.
Scalar multiplication on a homology class is induced by the scalar multiple of the identity map.
The homology map of a scalar multiple of a morphism is the corresponding scalar multiple of its homology map.
